head: 180588bc12c4fc60b6cf99b6d28347eeeb93949a
criteria: Known defect, later fixed in 35068d4. The Java report links to a task's state properties, while the GitLab adapter exports the report and execution logs without exporting the linked task state. GitLab artifact readers cannot open the diagnostic referenced by an incomplete report.
The affected path needs an unfinished task and a GitLab artifact. A normal complete run does not exhibit the broken diagnostic link.

head: 35068d4367df1ad2a28db3174088f7a4d4061657
criteria: The GitLab artifact now includes task-state files at the report-relative paths, including tasks in nested directories. A report that still asserts the previously missing task-state files are never exported is a false positive.
Execution logs still go under diagnostics. The fix does not add raw model streams or task error text to the export.

head: 44a5c5604df854257ebaa5bebc1d7c007fb04157
criteria: Known defect, later fixed in 455c11a. A candidate provisionally confirmed and later rejected can supply the representative wording of a grouped pending risk because representative selection also consults preliminary decisions and does not restrict them to the still-pending IDs.
This affects the wording of a review-required item when the grouped decisions diverge. The candidate is not thereby published as a confirmed defect.

head: 455c11a6abc46e9aec1c14087535a1ed4b7d44b0
criteria: Representative wording is selected only from still-pending IDs, including the fallback. A rejected peer can still contribute audit citations. Claiming that its wording remains eligible is a false positive.
This change does not decide whether a downstream failure is reachable or whether historical behavior is a binding requirement.

head: 96da98815c61f8d8747797f073c76945fe8247d7
criteria: The documented behavior intentionally compares the two supplied snapshots directly. A claim that using the supplied base instead of the merge base is itself a regression contradicts the explicitly documented contract.
A report may note how unrelated target-branch changes can appear when the chosen snapshots diverge. A stronger downstream claim needs evidence from actual consumers or requirements.
